name: overdrive
description: Overdrive, a PS5 game store. The scripts wrap the ps5-react build for this app.
//: JSON has no comments; npm ignores this key.
Linux: setup, build, build:app, preview, dev and test are the plain POSIX commands that
packaging/*.sh and the GitHub workflow use.
setup      Run once after cloning. Installs every dependency: the apt or Homebrew packages
for the preview, the PS5 build and the tests (asks for sudo on Linux), Pillow, and
the framework's npm packages. See packaging/setup.sh.
build      Builds the PS5 app, then packages Overdrive.exfat and update.zip here, like the
GitHub workflow. Needs LLVM 18, cmake, ninja, nasm, exfatprogs; asks for sudo
to mount the image while filling it. See packaging/build.sh.
build:app  The PS5 build only, into ps5-react/dist/PPSA99058. No sudo.
preview    Opens the app in the desktop preview window on this PC. No PS5 toolchain needed.
dev        Same window, rebuilt and restarted on every save under app/. State resets.
test       The framework's checks; run after changing rendering or input in ps5-react/.
Windows: the desktop preview and the packaging are POSIX C++ and shell work, so the
:windows commands run the same steps through WSL 2 from tools/launch.mjs, with
this checkout as /mnt/<drive>/<path>. `npm run setup:windows` installs the Ubuntu
toolchain on first run (it asks for sudo). The window uses WSLg.
OVERDRIVE_WSL_DISTRO picks a distro when more than one is installed;
`npm run <command>:windows -- --print` shows the WSL command without running it.
You type npm with the Windows Node, but the commands inside WSL use the WSL Node
and npm that setup:windows installs there.
setup:windows       Installs the WSL 2 toolchain. See setup.
doctor:windows      Reports what the WSL distro is missing. Run it first when a build does
not start.
preview:windows     See preview.
dev:windows         See dev.
test:windows        The framework's checks, then app/state's own tests.
build:windows       See build.
build:app:windows   See build:app.
macOS only: setup:mac creates ps5-react/.venv with Pillow; preview:mac, dev:mac and
doctor:mac run through that venv, with LLVM 18, Node and the MacPorts/SDL2
libraries when present. The Linux commands stay unchanged for other hosts.
build:mac  The PS5 app only, through that venv, into ps5-react/dist/PPSA99058. No sudo.
package:mac  Local only: builds Overdrive.exfat from the app above with newfs_exfat/hdiutil.
It writes no update.zip; the CI keeps producing that on Linux.
image:mac  build:mac, then package:mac.
CC=clang CXX=clang++: the preview is compiled with clang on every platform, since GCC
stops on a bounds warning in archive_preflight.cpp.

scripts.preview: cd ps5-react && CC=clang CXX=clang++ python3 tools/cli.py preview --app-dir ../app
scripts.dev: cd ps5-react && CC=clang CXX=clang++ python3 tools/cli.py preview --app-dir ../app --watch
scripts.test: cd ps5-react && CC=clang CXX=clang++ npm test
scripts.setup:mac: [ -x ps5-react/.venv/bin/python ] || python3 -m venv ps5-react/.venv; ps5-react/.venv/bin/pip install -r ps5-react/requirements.txt
scripts.preview:mac: cd ps5-react && CC=clang CXX=clang++ sh tools/mac-run.sh preview --app-dir ../app
scripts.dev:mac: cd ps5-react && CC=clang CXX=clang++ sh tools/mac-run.sh preview --app-dir ../app --watch
scripts.image:mac: npm run build:mac && npm run package:mac
